Vendored front-end libraries for the legacy station dashboard (legacy.html). They used to be loaded from public CDNs at run time, which made first paint
slow or blank when a CDN was slow or blocked. All are MIT licensed; the files are byte-for-byte the pinned upstream release files.

react.production.min.js
  source: https://unpkg.com/react@18.3.1/umd/react.production.min.js (React 18.3.1, MIT)
  sha256: d949f1c3687aedadcedac85261865f29b17cd273997e7f6b2bfc53b2f9d4c4dd
